newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks barely higher in early trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks barely higher in early trade.

text.p: U.S. stocks were barely higher in early trading on Friday despite an October jobs report that showed inflation remains under control, which gave a lift to bonds.
The Dow Jones industrial average was up six at 6,035, the NASDAQ Index up three at 1,224 and the S&P Index up one to 707.
The long bond rose 12/32 to yield 6.62 percent.
